items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, List of Answers on Topics 44:1
items.html: They are only reflected light without direct light, and they receive only a minute illumination from direct light, in the discernment of female light, which receives and does not bestow. And these ten Sefirot are discerned as ten discernments of conclusion, each of which concludes the Sefira that corresponds to it in the ten Sefirot of the generality of the Partzuf. (Chapter 1, Inner Light, Item 80)
